# Keshav Turbo Services

> Precision industrial steam turbine engineering — overhauling, reverse engineering, dynamic balancing, lube oil flushing, and OEM-compatible spares for steam turbines 5 kW to 27 MW. Based in Shamli, Uttar Pradesh, India. Serving power generation, sugar mills, paper mills, oil & gas, petrochemical, cement, and agro industries pan-India. 24×7 emergency breakdown support.

## Company Overview

Keshav Turbo Services (legal name: Keshav Enterprises) is a B2B industrial engineering company with 20+ years of field experience specialising in steam turbine maintenance, reverse engineering of obsolete turbine components, and supply of OEM-compatible industrial parts. The engineering team includes ex-OEM engineers from Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss & Morcom, Maxwatt, Man Turbo, KKK, and ABB.

## Services (7 Total)

- [Turbine Erection & Commissioning](/service/srv_1): Expert erection and commissioning for steam turbines, pumps, compressors, fans, condensers, EOT cranes, and pipeline work. OEMs: Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss India, Maxwatt.
- [Turnkey Overhauling & Maintenance](/service/srv_2): Executed by ex-OEM engineers from Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss, Maxwatt, Man Turbo, KKK, ABB. Pre-shutdown planning, condition reporting, spares management, 24×7 emergency support. Turnkey — all tools and manpower provided.
- [Precision Reverse Engineering](/service/srv_3): PMI-verified using 3D laser scanners, CMM, and copying lathes. Turbines 5 kW to 27 MW. Full engineering drawings with GD&T, tolerances, heat treatment specs. Lead time 4–8 weeks vs 12–18 months OEM import.
- [Dynamic Balancing & Rotor Machining](/service/srv_4): Journal grinding, polishing, labyrinth machining plus ISO 1940 / API dynamic balancing for rotors 50–2000 kg. Full compliance report.
- [Lube Oil Flushing](/service/srv_5): ISO 4406:99-compliant flushing with mobile centrifuge filter systems. 4–25 micron removal, up to 6,000 l/min. Target: API 614 Class 16/14/11.
- [Machine Alignment](/service/srv_6): Laser-precision alignment for turbines, gearboxes, pumps, fans, alternators, induction generators. Detailed report for every job.
- [Troubleshooting Service](/service/srv_7): On-site fault diagnosis — high vibration, bearing failure, governor instability, steam leakage, oil contamination, unexpected trips. Ex-OEM engineers deploy 24×7 across India.

## Product Categories (8 Categories, 105 Products)

### Industrial Filtration (23 products — prod_f1 to prod_f23)
Lube oil, control oil, and hydraulic filter elements. OEM-compatible with Triveni, Siemens, BHEL. Includes glass fiber, wire mesh CEP, tank breather (NBF), suction strainer (AS/TS), WaterSorp offline (WSNR), PTFE hydrophobic, return-line, duplex control oil assembly, duplex fabricated housing, RO assemblies, filter bag assemblies, wedge wire, dust collector cartridges, oil vapour extractor, HYDAC replacement, Pall replacement, Bhagwati replacement, and air-oil separator elements.

### Industrial Strainers (6 products — prod_st1 to prod_st6)
Simplex basket, duplex basket, conical/temporary, Y-type, pot/bucket type, and notch wire elements in CS and SS for all pipeline ratings.

### Expansion Joints (34 products — prod_e1 to prod_e31 + variants e1b, e3b, e3c)
SS metallic bellows (DN 15–12,000), axial, double/single/wide-arch rubber, heat exchanger bellows, universal metallic, fabric/non-metallic (to 1000°C), pressure balance, ring reinforced, externally pressurised, lateral, angular/gimbal hinged, metallic vibration absorber, elbow pressure balance, steam crossover bellows, FCCU high-temperature, jacketed, clamshell retrofit, lens type, rectangular, district heating, tank farm service, cryogenic LNG/LPG, scrubber/exhaust gas, hygienic sanitary, hinged single-plane, T-type pressure balance, octagonal profile, thick-wall heavy-duty, MS slip type, industrial airflow damper, dismantling joint, MS & SS duct systems.

### Turbine Spares (23 products — prod_ts1 to prod_ts23)
Carbon & graphite gland sealing rings, labyrinth shaft packings, babbitt journal bearings & thrust pads, ESV valves, lube oil pumps & mechanical seals, high-purity electrographite rings, complete rotor assemblies, precision gears & worm wheels, nozzles & diaphragms, mechanical centrifugal governors, throttle/control valves, high/low speed couplings, flexible disc packs (MetaFlex), boiler sight glasses, spherical WM-80 bearings (TDPS alternator), leaf springs, rotor journal polishing service, fulcrum pins, spiral conveyor screws, nylon gear coupling sleeves, KTR BoWex gear couplings, shear pins, Dowty hydraulic oil pumps.

### Industrial Rubber Products (2 products — prod_r1 to prod_r2)
Custom extruded rubber profiles & seals (neoprene/EPDM/nitrile/silicone), and heavy-duty anti-vibration rubber mounts (5–5000 kg per mount).

### Flexible Hoses & Assemblies (10 products — prod_h1 to prod_h8 + h1b, h1c)
SS corrugated flexible metal hose assemblies, SS pre-fitted assemblies, generator/engine exhaust bellows, PTFE lined smooth bore assemblies, high-pressure hydraulic rubber hose (SAE 100R, to 400 bar), PTFE braided corrugated transfer hose, metallic flexible hose (corrugated core), steam hose (to 210°C), food grade hose (FDA/EU), oxygen & specialty gas hose.

### Electronic Equipments (6 products — prod_ee1 to prod_ee6)
Vibration monitoring probes (Shinkawa-compatible, API 670), magnetic pickup sensors (Woodward-compatible), ASCO 8210 explosion-proof solenoid valves, Beacon analog tachometer gauges, RTD & sensors (PT100/PT1000 for power plants), SEMIKRON SKN240/16 rectifier diodes.

### Hydraulic Components (1 product — prod_hv1) ← NEW
Directional control valves from Bosch Rexroth, Parker, Yuken, Vickers (Eaton), Atos, Duplomatic. CETOP 3/5/7 (D03/D05/D08), ISO 4401. Solenoid (24V DC/110V AC/220V AC), manual, pilot-operated. 4/2, 4/3, 5/2 spool; 2/2 poppet. Flow 15–350 LPM, up to 350 bar. ATEX explosion-proof option. Proportional valves available.

## Industries Served (7 Industries)

- **Power Generation** (ind_1): Turbine overhauling, erection, filter spares for 5–27 MW thermal power plants.
- **Sugar Mills & Distilleries** (ind_2): Back-pressure turbine services. Triveni and Belliss & Morcom specialists. 24×7 crushing-season emergency support.
- **Paper & Pulp Mills** (ind_3): Continuous-operation turbine maintenance, duplex basket strainers, metallic expansion joints.
- **Oil & Gas** (ind_4): API 614 filtration, API 670 vibration monitoring, PTFE hoses, high-pressure hydraulic hoses, babbitt bearings.
- **Petrochemical & Refineries** (ind_5): Inconel/Hastelloy bellows, PTFE expansion joints, ASME-code strainers, FCCU expansion joints.
- **Agro & Food Processing** (ind_6): FDA-grade PTFE hoses, anti-vibration mounts, breather filters, steam turbine maintenance.
- **Cement & Construction** (ind_7): Kiln gearbox filters, kiln exhaust expansion joints, crusher anti-vibration mounts, babbitt bearings for kiln support rollers.
